title: Cheque deposits, clearing and uncredited cheques - support procedure
content: Keep the deposit acknowledgement, date and non-sensitive amount for review. The demo agent checks the configured clearing status and any return reason; no real clearing deadline or credit guarantee is inferred from the deposit date alone.
